title: 第1章  武道盛世第2章  G级人才
slug: 从龙象般若功开始创武成圣
content_zh:
天一武院，一年一度招生季。
新一批学员，正在紧张的等待面试。
苏青也是其中一员。
他站在队伍里，耳边听着旁边人的窃窃私语。
“武者莽就是了，面试都是多此一举，只要肉身够强，就能横推一切，要脑子干什么！”
“没脑子你怎么修行新武学？不修行新武学，你就没资格进入武道圣胎里，进行三倍速，五倍速的武学修行！”
“那我也不怕，我报了面试班的！”
“我更不怕，我送了礼的！”
“我家有关系！”
“我爸是副校！”
世风日下，人心不古啊！
一群关系户，没有真本事，就想着走捷径！
苏青叹了口气，将他准备送考官的挂历在袖子间藏好。
老爹说这挂历上绘的是武仙真迹，是他花了三万块在古董市场淘换来的好东西。
应该是能作为他进入武院的敲门砖，让那面试官心动的。
当然，就算这敲门砖不成。
他也还有真本事在身的！
穿越来到这方武道盛世之后。
他就在思索，相比于本地土著，他的优势是什么。
是超凡大师级的游戏操作，还是抢外卖神券的逆天手速？

不，这都不是！
是前世那个无法修行武学，但向武之心不死的璀璨文明，臆想出来的诸多玄奇武学！
九阴九阳。
斗转星移。
三分归元气。
神象镇狱劲！
虽然都是假的，但他们说的跟真的一样！
而在这方武道盛世，一拳爆星的武道家固然让人敬畏。
但更让人敬畏的还是开创武学的创武师。
鼓励武学创新，优待创武名师。
这是大夏联邦坚持数百年的国策。
也让大夏联邦涌现出一门门针对不同妖魔灾祸的玄奇武学。
除了政策倾斜，地位尊崇之外。
content_en:
Tianyi Martial Arts Academy has its annual admissions season.
The new batch of students are nervously waiting for interviews.
Su Qing is also one of them.
He stood in the queue, listening to the whispers of the people next to him.
"A warrior is just reckless. Interviews are unnecessary. As long as your body is strong enough, you can push through everything. What do you need your brain for?"
"How can you practice new martial arts without any brains? If you don't practice new martial arts, you are not qualified to enter the holy womb of martial arts and practice martial arts at three times or five times the speed!"
"Then I'm not afraid, I signed up for the interview class!"
"I'm not afraid, I gave you a gift!"
"My family has connections!"
"My dad is the vice principal!"
The world is declining, and people's hearts are not as old as they used to be!
A group of well-connected people have no real skills and just want to take shortcuts!
Su Qing sighed and hid the calendar he was going to send to the examiner in his sleeve.
Dad said that the picture on this wall calendar is an authentic work of Wu Xian, a good thing that he bought in the antique market for 30,000 yuan.
It should be a stepping stone for him to enter the martial arts academy and make the interviewer's heart flutter.
Of course, even if this stepping stone fails.
He also has real abilities!
After traveling through time, we came to this place where martial arts flourished.
He was thinking about what his advantages were compared to the local natives.
Is it the extraordinary master-level game operation, or the incredible hand speed to grab the takeaway coupons?
No, none of this!
It's the many mysterious martial arts imagined by the brilliant civilization in the previous life that was unable to practice martial arts, but had an undying desire for martial arts!
Nine yin and nine yang.
Time flies.
Three points return to vitality.
The power of the divine elephant to suppress the prison!
Although they are all fake, what they say is true!
And in this prosperous age of martial arts, martial arts masters who can explode with one punch are certainly awe-inspiring.
But what is even more awe-inspiring is the founder of martial arts.
Encourage innovation in martial arts and give preferential treatment to famous martial arts masters.
This is the national policy that the Daxia Federation has adhered to for hundreds of years.
It also caused the emergence of various mysterious martial arts in the Daxia Federation to deal with different demon disasters.
In addition to policy preference and respected status.
